newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares suffer from strong crown.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares suffer from strong crown.

text.p: A strong Norwegian crown burdened currency-sensitive shares on Wednesday, helping to drag down the Oslo Bourse Total index, dealers said.
The index finished 0.42 percent lower at 1,066.08 points.
Heavy turnover of 1.4 million crowns was inflated by the selling of more than 300 million crowns worth of shares in computer retailer Santech Micro Group and insurer Storebrand.
The crown firmed against the dollar and the German mark to help weaken shares like Norsk Hydro, whose products include oil and metals. Oil company Saga Petroleum and metals maker Elkem also fell.
Hydro edged down 0.3 percent to 371.50 crowns, Saga's A share fell 2.4 percent to 121 crowns and Elkem dropped 2.0 percent to 96 crowns.
Losses were recorded everywhere except in the banking index, which gained strength. Fokus Bank, which will present annual results on Thursday morning, was up 0.99 percent at 51 crowns.
